# Suryansh Mishra · Code

> Coding portfolio of Suryansh Mishra, an AI engineer in Noida, India, and the co-founder and CTO of Alethman. He builds LLM agents, RAG pipelines and the systems under them.

## Who he is

Suryansh Mishra is an AI engineer from Noida, India. He is the co-founder and CTO of Alethman, where he built the engine that follows how news stories form and spread, and a forward deployed engineer at InboxKit. He studies computer science at UPES with a minor in AI from IIT Ropar, contributes to Rocket.Chat, and has won three national hackathons. He also paints and writes poetry.

## What this site contains

- [Coding portfolio](https://code.suryanshmishra.com/): a single page styled like a browser, with tabs for an introduction, an about section with skills and a contact form, AI and ML projects, full-stack projects, and extras (cloud, cybersecurity and other projects).
- [Linktree](https://linktr.ee/mishrasuryansh)
